newsitem.title: USA: NUR to take Q4 reserve, sees yr loss.
newsitem.headline: NUR to take Q4 reserve, sees yr loss.

text.p: NUR Advanced Technologies Ltd said today it will take a fourth quarter reserve against the full $2.5 million of receivables due from two companies which recently filed for bankruptcy in Israel.
The companies are controlled by Moshe Nur, the former chairman of NUR Advanced Technologies Ltd.

In addition, NUR said it requested auditors investigate the annual audit of its financial statements, which may result in additional reserves and losses. Although the investigation is ongoing, the company said it expects the loss for the year ended December 31, 1996 will be at least $6.0 million.

The digital jet printer company added that board member David Fuchs has been appointed acting chief financial officer to replace Carlos Sason, who resigned as the company's chief financial officer. No reason for his departure was given.
